source: Captured from repos/web (src/utils/mermaidThemeConfig.ts, mermaidSvgPostProcessor.ts) in Chromium with mermaid 11.16.1. Token values are set on :root for mapped entries; tokenMap names the web custom properties. The configs were re-recorded from @hagicode/hagilight-mermaid after the series palette (pie, Gantt, git graph and the other categorical charts) was added, so the colour variables beyond the node, edge and cluster roles no longer exist in the web app; the SVG structures are unchanged.
